verdicts.why: Agatha All Along ep. 4: after Sharon's death the coven summons a replacement green witch and Rio comes, walking the Road with them (undercover service counts); ep. 7 reveals she is Death, and in ep. 8 she attacks Agatha and claims her, turning on the coven. 'Agatha's coven' is the dataset's existing name.

Whitney is an outsider to the Council of Nine until she seizes it. In ep. 2 Chadwick tells her the Council scrapped her Zero Matter work, and in ep. 6 she gets a meeting with a Council that 'rarely met with outsiders'. The infobox lists Anvil Studios and the Council only, so the second Council stage (before Isodyne) has no basis.

HANDOFF says a person's hero and villain files list the same groups. A:st-leo-fitz goes from the Framework's HYDRA straight back to S.H.I.E.L.D. in S4: after waking in ep. 20 Fitz is taken by Aida, which is an abduction, not a move, and he rejoins the team. The S4 Independent stage and the S4 left are not departures.

Powell is NYPD from 2005 (his file is shown on screen) and has no tie to Fisk until Fisk recruits him into the Anti-Vigilante Task Force ('Recruited by the Mayor'). The leading Fisk's Empire stage is wrong, and the last stage stays.

His first title on file is Eyes of Wakanda (one episode). His Navy SEAL and JSOC service is a past group told by Ross in Black Panther, so by the settled rule it is keyed to his first title. The Wakanda stage stays at Black Panther.

In ep. 12 Zip tries to strangle Shades on Diamondback's orders and is shot dead. He never quits or turns on his boss, and the dataset keeps Diamondback (T:st-diamondback) in the Stokes Crime Family. Death is not a departure, so the Independent stage and the left have no move behind them.

From Luke Cage S2 ep. 1 D.W. runs his merchandise business out of Pop's, and in ep. 13 he takes over the barbershop's lease ('this place is Switzerland'), so it is his real workplace. The wiki lists Pop's Barber Shop as his affiliation. A leading Independent stage has precedent (Lonnie Lincoln).

held: an unnamed workplace is an owner call. 'Zoey Lyonne Art School' is a wiki label. The screen says only the 'Zoey Lyonne Arts Scholarship', the wiki's own screenshot of the venue shows no school name, and Jeri's 'university quartet' line leaves unclear where Kith teaches. So no on-screen group name backs the stage.

Ironheart ep. 4: Madeline left Kamar-Taj to raise Zelma in Chicago and runs her own shop, whose sign on screen reads 'Stanton's Sweets, Reads & More'. Zelma greets customers with 'Welcome to Stanton's'. It is her real workplace, so her last stage is the shop, not Independent.
Same as above: after leaving the Masters she runs Stanton's Sweets, Reads & More (Ironheart ep. 4), so she does not end in no group, and the left at Ironheart goes.
The Defenders eps. 4-6: Alexandra settled in K'un-Lun, was banished with the other fingers and only then founded the Hand. So K'un-Lun comes first, and the leading Hand stage has no basis.
The Defenders ('Ashes, Ashes'): Murakami lived in K'un-Lun and left with Alexandra, and together they formed the Hand. So K'un-Lun comes before the Hand, and the leading Hand stage has no basis.

HANDOFF says a person's hero and villain files list the same groups, and the twin A:sv-curt-connors-ssm has ESU then Independent. Connors is lead scientist of the ESU labs (ep. 3) and in the season 2 finale leaves for the Everglades to escape Warren's blackmail.
